market_question: Will Silver (SI) hit (HIGH) $120 by end of June?
reasoning: Silver would need to more than triple from current ~$33 to $120 in 15 months, an unprecedented move exceeding all-time highs near $50. No fundamental catalyst supports such a surge, making the true probability far lower than the implied 6.7%.
evidence_points: Silver all-time high is ~$50, reached in 1980 and 2011; $120 has never been approached.
Current SI front-month futures settle around $33, requiring a 3.6x increase in ~15 months.
Commodity spikes of this magnitude without hyperinflation or extreme supply shock are historically implausible.
